C01.setup: Direct Python OpenAI and Anthropic SDK applications
C01.status: conformance candidate; NOT an accepted support row
C01.identity_mapping: INTERFACE.md: step = run.label or operation (unique per run), attempt = SDK-internal retries + 1, event/charge id = workflow:version:run:step:attempt

cost_categories.model: estimated from zeroth.instrumentation.rate_card (version 2026-09-10/litellm-1.98.0); usage split retained, cached tokens subtracted from input
cost_categories.unmeasured: missing usage, unlisted model, undeclared non-official base URL, aborted stream, failed or retried attempt

supported_modes: chat.completions and responses (sync/async), messages create and stream helper (sync/async)
streaming completion with include_usage; aborted/closed streams unmeasured
SDK-internal retries charged per attempt; provider exceptions charged unmeasured
tool-use cycle (two model charges + caller tool charge)
cancellation via asyncio timeout; thread-pool fan-out with copy_context
coexisting httpx event hooks and OpenTelemetry spans
excluded_modes: live provider calls, real request ids and invoices (NOT_RUN)
images, audio, realtime, batch, files, hosted tool charges
Azure OpenAI deployment mapping; proxy billing identity (recorded unknown unless declared)
retries preceding a final failure are not individually visible (retries_unobserved)

cost_categories.unmeasured: missing usage_metadata, unlisted model, provider outside {openai, anthropic}, raised model call

C04.status: conformance candidate; NOT an accepted support row
C04.identity_mapping: INTERFACE.md: step = agent role or task name per LLM call (planner, planner#2; llm for flows); one charge per LLMCallCompletedEvent built from the event's own fields, LLMCallFailedEvent = unmeasured attempt; crews, tasks and agent executions are aggregates on the run summary; attribution by the emitter's context, with Crew.kickoff wrapped to bind crew->run synchronously in the application thread for async_execution tasks

cost_categories.model: estimated from the rate card using the event's usage dict (cached prompt tokens subtracted); provider from the provider/model name prefix
cost_categories.unmeasured: missing or zero usage, unlisted model, bare model name without default_provider, failed call

bare model names recorded unmeasured with provider unknown

C05.setup: Existing AutoGen AgentChat applications, Python (0.7.x maintained line)
C05.status: conformance candidate; NOT an accepted support row
C05.identity_mapping: INTERFACE.md: each agent's model client wrapped in ZerothChatCompletionClient with a declared model, provider and step; one charge per create/create_stream from CreateResult.usage; teams and termination are the framework's, the outcome the application's

cost_categories.model: estimated from the rate card using RequestUsage prompt/completion tokens; cache_split unavailable (see limits)
cost_categories.unmeasured: zero prompt and completion tokens, unlisted model, provider outside {openai, anthropic}, raised or cancelled call, stream closed before its result
cost_categories.not_recorded: CreateResult.cached (AutoGen cache hit) is not a provider call

supported_modes: AssistantAgent runs, RoundRobinGroupChat multi-agent turns with TextMention and MaxMessage termination, model_client_stream runs, asyncio.gather fan-out, application retry and fallback
missing usage unmeasured; cache hit not charged; cancellation token -> unmeasured attempt
AutoGen 0.2 / AG2 environments raise an import diagnostic naming the unsupported row
excluded_modes: live provider calls (NOT_RUN); tool use, handoffs and OpenAIChatCompletionClient/AnthropicChatCompletionClient themselves not exercised (fake clients)

cache split: RequestUsage carries none, so OpenAI-style inclusive prompt counts price cached tokens at the input rate (overstatement of exactly cached x (input - cache_read); the harness asserts that magnitude on the cached reference run) and Anthropic-style exclusive counts drop cached tokens
autogen-core pins protobuf 5.29 against this environment's protobuf 6.32, so every check runs in a pinned subprocess venv

evidence.tests: test_c05_autogen.py (3 checks: AG2 diagnostic in the harness environment; floor and current pinned environments, each reference + modes)
evidence.reconciled: expected_ledger.json v1 at both pins and v2 at current, exact on the 8 uncached runs and exact-magnitude on the cached run

C07.status: conformance candidate; NOT an accepted support row

C07.identity_mapping: INTERFACE.md by hand: event_id workflow:version:run:step:attempt, charge_id charge:+event_id, one charge per physical call, one money-free summary per run, outcomes with declared maturity; the TypeScript worker embeds a copy of the four-model rate card and prices in exact 1e-8 integer units

cost_categories.model: estimated from the rate card (Python: zeroth.instrumentation.rate_card; TypeScript: embedded copy, parity-tested through identical ledgers)
cost_categories.unmeasured: missing usage or unlisted model (cost_usd null)

supported_modes: both workers reproduce the frozen workload for two versions with identical ledgers and identical normalised version-comparison decisions

Python: Recorder(raise_on_error=False) with bounded replay of recorder.lost
--experimental-strip-types path (Node 22.6+ semantics) reconciles

the TypeScript rate card is a copy: drift is caught only by the parity test at the pinned SDK version

evidence.reconciled: expected_ledger.json v1 and v2 through both workers; parity verdict abstain
